items.text: Among adults registered with the six practices who had at least two eGFR results between January 2019 and June 2026, what are the sensitivity and positive predictive value of a chronic kidney disease stage 3 to 5 code against laboratory-defined disease (two eGFR values below 60 at least 90 days apart)?
items.population: Adults registered on 30 June 2026 with at least two eGFR results in the window
items.intervention: Chronic kidney disease stage 3 to 5 code on the problem list (index test)
items.outcome: Sensitivity, positive predictive value, specificity and negative predictive value
items.setting: Six general practices in one primary care network

finer: Feasible within 60 analyst hours on an approved extract; interesting to GPs, pharmacists and planners; novel locally; ethical as service evaluation of pseudonymised records; relevant to a funding decision in March 2027.
summary: One accuracy question with the code as index test and laboratory results as reference standard.
